item.title: World Cup 2026: ‘Dai Dai,’ ‘Champions,’ ‘El Último Baile,’ ‘Llego’ & More Best Songs to Celebrate
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where music meets sports! With the 2026 FIFA World Cup in full swing, we're excited to dive into the world of soccer and soundtracks. I'm your host, and let's get started!"
[Upbeat music transitions]
Host: "This year's World Cup has an official anthem, 'Dai Dai', performed by Shakira and Burna Boy. This reggaetón-tinged, Afrobeats song is part of the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album, featuring 18 tracks from artists around the globe. According to FIFA president Gianni Fantino, this project aims to unite fans worldwide through the power of music and football."
[Music clip: "Dai Dai" by Shakira and Burna Boy]
Host: "But that's not all - former Brazilian soccer icon Ronaldinho has launched an album called Camisa 10, with songs by Sean Paul, Justin Quiles, and more. And other artists like J Balvin, The Rolling Stones, and Carlos Vives are also getting in on the action with soccer-themed songs."
[Music clip: Sample of Camisa 10 album]
Host: "Billboard has even curated a list of the ultimate World Cup songs, showcasing the universal language of music and football. And with the tournament being held across three countries - Canada, Mexico, and the United States - it's an exciting time for fans around the world."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast! Don't forget to check out Billboard's Top 2026 World Cup Songs list. We'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
